notes.title: Blocked In is FREE & Oculus ready (and other news)!
notes.notes:
Heya everyone! 

Thanks for all your support! It has been a year since Blocked In was originally released on steam and even longer on the good old Dk1 & Dk2 for those who can still remember those days :) it's heart warming to hear that people still have fond memories of the first version for the DK1 <3 To celebrate the anniversary I decided to make Blocked In 'FREE'! And it also works smoothly on the Oculus CV1!

Since last year I've been working hard on my new diorama  [b]'Diorama No.4 : The Fernweh opera'[/b] in which you will visit an impossible intergalactic opera, performed by a 30 ft opera singer and explore her dressing room. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22252996/d042b58f1ee3bea442fba7cce7c9e9321c76c4a3.jpg[/img]

The first version was showcased at the Frankfurter Buchmesse last year and it is a sequel to [b]'Diorama No.2 : Der Grosse Gottlieb'[/b]. The Opera has been written by poet Maud Vanhauwaert and composed by Misha Velthuis and performed by opera singer: Annina Gieré. This will also be the first character driven diorama. 

To stay up to date, try out future demos or see sneak peeks of things to come, check out my facebook site: http://www.facebook.com/shoeboxdiorama. 

I'm a one man operation so my updates are a bit slow, but I hope to see everyone around! 
 
All the best, 
Daniel Ernst

notes.title: The Progression structure is gone!
notes.notes:
Heya everyone, 

Some users had problems with the progression structure that was in place. Since start of this week the progression structure was taken out and every view is freely accessible. Your dioramas should have updated themselves. Enjoy!

Best,
Daniel

PS if you like the experience feel free to leave a review!

notes.title: Welcome to 'The Shoebox Diorama'!
notes.notes:
Dear Visitor, 

After 2,5 years experimenting with VR, I finally reached the official starting point for my project : [b]'The Shoebox Diorama' [/b], an ongoing series of fantastical VR dioramas. I hope to spend many many years to come exploring the depths of VR and creating these type of wondrous interactive illustrations. 

And there is still so much more, much more to share in the coming months, for example; [b] 'Diorama No.0 : The Table of Contents' [/b], the illusive  [b]'Diorama No.2 : Der Grosse Gottlieb' [/b] and  [b]Dear Pigeon Man [b]. 

If you want to support my dioramas share my steampage to press, friends enthusiasts or random people in the streets! 

All the best and hope to see you around, 
Daniel
